Normalize expression input to log2(TPM + 1)

Source: R/00_utils.R
normalize_expression_scale.Rd

`raw` means untransformed TPM, not raw RNA-seq counts. Raw counts must be normalized to an appropriate expression unit such as TPM before they are supplied to this function. `processed` means expression already transformed as log2(TPM + 1).

Usage

normalize_expression_scale(
  x,
  input_scale = c("raw", "processed"),
  object_name = "expression data"
)

Arguments

x

Numeric expression matrix.

input_scale

Either `"raw"` (TPM) or `"processed"` (log2(TPM + 1)).

object_name

Name used in error messages.

Value

A list containing log-expression and the declared input scale.
